Callout.Name: Broken Down in the Dark
Callout.Message: Vehicle stopped in a live lane with no lights.

Script.Line: There are no lights on it at all. None.
It is right over the crest and you do not see it until you are on top of it.
I have put my own car behind it with the lights on. That is all I can do.

Lines.Approach: It is in a lane with no lights on it and the traffic is swerving. That is the whole call.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
